name: source
use: why it was registered — the growth trigger

name: strongNumber
use: the resolved Strong's code — the key

name: stepTransliteration
use: romanised form; never shown without the gloss

name: count
use: STEP token frequency — NOT a verse count, may be capped

name: is_own_lemma
use: 1 = no ': ' head; the code is its own lemma and the gloss is the sense

name: lemma_key
use: the base code the tree belongs to

name: preview
use: the full interlinear HTML — the source of span

name: position
use: running code index in the verse — the key with verse_id

name: surface
use: the English word this code belongs to; repeats across a word's codes

name: morph_code
use: the grammatical layer — one, aligned with the code

name: runs_over
use: the scope value, e.g. the word

name: config_version
use: the config that ran — pinned before any work

name: resume_point
use: the step to resume at on continue

name: run_id
use: the run that ran the check

name: word
use: the word the check was over

name: word
use: the word this interaction is about — durable across runs

name: at_step
use: where to resume — makes it a pause not a fork

name: preset
use: the context that lets it be answered (JSON)

name: tried
use: what the app attempted before asking

name: gloss
use: the lemma's English gloss — the meaning the net matches on

name: registry_match
use: the registry word covering this lemma, or NULL (NULL+candidate = missing registry word)

name: tag
use: IB label carried onto the stamp

name: lemma_key
use: base Strong's of the span (denormalised for continuity/join)

name: candidate_tag
use: the IB label from the seed

name: anchor_verse_id
use: first verse of the run — the anchor

name: needs_review
use: 1 when verse_count > passage.review_over — confirm one passage not several

name: verse_id
use: the verse (unique — one passage per verse)
